_: Official NeoSkript addons: made and maintained by Xena Studios, released and tested with NeoSkript. Shown on /addons/. Each entry: name, summary (one sentence), adds (what syntax it gives scripts), example (a few lines of script), version, status (beta or stable), and links (modrinth, source, docs; any can be left out).

official.name: NeoSkript YAML
official.summary: YAML files from scripts, with skript-yaml's syntax: scripts written for skript-yaml run unchanged.
official.adds: Loading, reading, changing and saving YAML files, with their comments and headers. Saves are written off the server's threads and never half written, on Paper and Folia.
official.example:
load yaml "plugins/MyScript/config.yml" as "config"
set yaml value "spawn.world" of "config" to "world"
save yaml "config"
